entries.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: MMO Idle gale-shard material-tab icon, final 32x32, readable at 16px and 24px.
Edit request: Transform the supplied essence icon into ONE gale Shard icon. Preserve the reference's luminous stepped pixel-art treatment, inner brightness, small clean dark edge, and compact footprint. Replace its circular orb silhouette and inner motif with the shard described here. This is a new comparison candidate; never show a sheet of several icons.
Subject: ONE compact upright chipped crystal fragment, approximately round-square in visual weight but with an irregular pentagonal broken outline, a short pointed bottom and one missing small upper corner. Its whole silhouette must use the same shared crystal form as the other eight shards. A material chunk with broken mineral facets, not a relic plaque, badge, bottle, sphere, jewellery setting or complete artifact.
Internal symbol: one broad bright curved gust incision that hooks around a dark wedge of negative space; one mark, no extra wind trails. The mark occupies at least half the crystal's face, broad and instantly legible. It looks embedded as bright inner essence, not printed on a flat panel.
Palette: exact lane colour #7fe3ff as the dominant face, brighter pale tinted inner glyph, a restrained deep same-hue shadow. No gold rim unless the lane itself is amber. For Iron, keep muted olive-grey #7fe3ff; for Bone, stay lavender #7fe3ff, not white.
Composition: centred on square transparent canvas; fills 78 percent of height and 68 percent of width, with even padding. Shared chunky crystal proportions across the family; avoid long needle or thin splinter shapes.
Style: crisp intentional pixel clusters with three or four broad stepped shades, like the supplied existing essence icon. Luminous material achieved with bright solid clusters and one thin highlighted edge; no blurry exterior halo, no realistic or smooth painterly rendering, no thick black cartoon outline. No microtexture or dither.
Constraints: genuine transparent background. One icon only, no words, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, ornamental border, circular container, iron plate, scene, floor, cast shadow or loose particles.
